Home / Regions

Eighteen regions. One register.

Region names follow the Philippine Standard Geographic Code list used by the upstream directory. Counts show registered LGUs in the current snapshot, not all LGUs in the region.

Where the register reaches

  • BARMM 1 registered LGU Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM)
  • Bicol Region 14 registered LGUs Region V (Bicol Region)
  • Cagayan Valley 10 registered LGUs Region II (Cagayan Valley)
  • CALABARZON 43 registered LGUs Region IV-A (CALABARZON)
  • CAR 2 registered LGUs Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR)
  • Caraga 4 registered LGUs Region XIII (Caraga)
  • Central Luzon 26 registered LGUs Region III (Central Luzon)
  • Central Visayas 6 registered LGUs Region VII (Central Visayas)
  • Davao Region 4 registered LGUs Region XI (Davao Region)
  • Eastern Visayas 10 registered LGUs Region VIII (Eastern Visayas)
  • Ilocos Region 16 registered LGUs Region I (Ilocos Region)
  • MIMAROPA Region 5 registered LGUs MIMAROPA Region
  • NCR 10 registered LGUs National Capital Region (NCR)
  • NIR 5 registered LGUs Negros Island Region (NIR)
  • Northern Mindanao 3 registered LGUs Region X (Northern Mindanao)
  • SOCCSKSARGEN 6 registered LGUs Region XII (SOCCSKSARGEN)
  • Western Visayas 6 registered LGUs Region VI (Western Visayas)
  • Zamboanga Peninsula 3 registered LGUs Region IX (Zamboanga Peninsula)
